test_registry.name: Role-Aware Path Traversal & IDOR Check
test_registry.description: Validates route permissions across privilege levels and tests object reference tampering.
test_registry.prerequisites: Valid test account credentials or multi-role session tokens.
test_registry.limitations: Context-dependent; cannot comprehensively test complex stateful multi-step business logic.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Requires confirmed cross-account unauthorized resource retrieval or unauthorized modification.

test_registry.name: Security Header Baseline Audit
test_registry.description: Audits HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Permissions-Policy on HTTP responses.
test_registry.limitations: Static analysis only; reports policy absence across root and API routes.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Absence of protective response headers in production/HTTPS context.

test_registry.name: Context-Aware CORS Policy Validation
test_registry.description: Probes cross-origin resource sharing behavior with null and arbitrary origin headers.
test_registry.prerequisites: Reachable HTTP/S web service with cross-origin handlers.
test_registry.limitations: Wildcard CORS is only flagged as vulnerable when paired with sensitive data or credentials reflection.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Response reflects untrusted origin alongside Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true or exposes sensitive payloads.

test_registry.name: Dangerous HTTP Method Behavioral Probe
test_registry.description: Tests if TRACE, PUT, or DELETE methods execute rather than simply reflecting in OPTIONS headers.
test_registry.limitations: Safe probing only; does not perform destructive write or delete actions.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Requires active behavioral acceptance (e.g. TRACE body reflection or unexpected 200/204 on probe).

test_registry.name: Exposed Sensitive Files & Source Control
test_registry.description: Searches for exposed .git, .env, backups, database dumps, and server configuration files.
test_registry.prerequisites: Target route discovery enabled with dictionary wordlist.
test_registry.limitations: Must filter out custom soft-404 responses before classifying an exposed file as valid.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Payload content verification matches known magic bytes (e.g., git index header, config keys) and status 200.

test_registry.name: Software Supply Chain & Vulnerable Library Audit
test_registry.description: Identifies client-side JavaScript libraries and dependency versions against known CVE databases.
test_registry.prerequisites: Crawled HTML and scripts containing version markers.
test_registry.limitations: Manifest detection alone is informational; requires confirmed vulnerable component version in active use.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Confirmed match of client-side dependency version with documented critical/high CVEs (Retire.js).

test_registry.name: TLS Protocol & Cipher Suite Cryptographic Audit
test_registry.description: Checks for deprecated TLS v1.0/v1.1 protocols, weak CBC ciphers, and certificate expiration/mismatch.
test_registry.prerequisites: HTTPS target on port 443 or custom SSL/TLS port.
test_registry.limitations: Does not audit server-side database encryption-at-rest or internal secret storage.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Server establishes handshake using obsolete TLS versions or expired/untrusted certificate.

test_registry.name: Cookie Security Attributes Inspection
test_registry.description: Verifies Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite flags on Set-Cookie headers over TLS.
test_registry.prerequisites: Session cookies generated during crawling or authentication.
test_registry.limitations: Limited to cookies observed during crawler and passive scanner passes.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Sensitive or session cookies set without Secure flag or appropriate SameSite policy.

test_registry.name: Context-Aware Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
test_registry.description: Injects non-destructive canary tokens into query and body parameters and checks unencoded reflection in executable HTML/JS context.
test_registry.prerequisites: Parameterized input endpoints discovered by crawler.
test_registry.limitations: String reflection alone is NOT proof of XSS. Flagged as potential unless unescaped DOM breakout is verified.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Unsanitized script execution context in response body without contextual encoding.

test_registry.name: Differential SQL Injection Verification
test_registry.description: Tests parameter inputs with Boolean differential and safe syntax probes to identify SQL parsing flaws.
test_registry.limitations: Database error messages alone indicate error disclosure (A10); confirmed SQLi requires differential response validation.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Consistent Boolean differential response change or controlled time delay differential.

test_registry.name: Rate-Limiting & Architectural Abuse Guard
test_registry.description: Observes rate limiting and anti-automation protections on authentication and sensitive resource routes.
test_registry.limitations: Automated scanners cannot evaluate threat models or business logic architecture without human review.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Heuristic finding only; requires manual threat modeling and architecture review.

test_registry.name: Authentication Session Handling & Token Exposure
test_registry.description: Checks for session tokens exposed in URL query parameters and missing invalidation upon logout.
test_registry.limitations: Does not perform brute-force credential attacks.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Session identifier leaked in URL path/query or reused across authenticated state transitions.

test_registry.name: Subresource Integrity (SRI) on External Resources
test_registry.category_title: A08:2025 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
test_registry.description: Checks third-party CDN scripts and styles for valid cryptographic integrity attributes.
test_registry.prerequisites: HTML responses loading external third-party CDN scripts.
test_registry.limitations: First-party hosted scripts do not typically require SRI attributes.
test_registry.validation_criteria: External CDN script tag lacking valid integrity and crossorigin attributes.

test_registry.name: Security Logging & Alerting Verification
test_registry.description: Verifies whether simulated security events trigger audit log entries and alerts.
test_registry.limitations: Scanners have zero visibility into internal application logs unless API or SIEM integration is provided.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Requires manual review or SIEM log verification.

test_registry.name: Verbose Exception & Stack Trace Disclosure
test_registry.description: Sends malformed input and observes whether stack traces, SQL syntax errors, or debug internals leak in responses.
test_registry.limitations: Distinguishes between clean error pages and verbose internal diagnostic leaks.
test_registry.validation_criteria: Response body contains runtime stack trace signatures, environment variables, or database query snippets.

findings.title: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information (HTTP Without TLS)
findings.verification_notes: Target runs on unencrypted HTTP protocol allowing passive eavesdropping and man-in-the-middle manipulation. [Retested 6:11:46 PM: Confirmed Remediated]
findings.remediation_guidance: Enforce HTTPS on port 443 with valid TLS certificates and configure automatic HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects.

findings.title: Missing Core HTTP Security Headers
findings.verification_notes: Observed HTTP response lacked defensive security headers: Content-Security-Policy (CSP), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
findings.remediation_guidance: Configure web server / reverse proxy to include HSTS (max-age=31536000), CSP, X-Frame-Options: DENY, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

findings.title: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
findings.verification_notes: Detected via OWASP ZAP Automation Framework (Plugin ID: 10020). Evidence: N/A
findings.remediation_guidance:
Modern Web browsers support the Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options HTTP headers. Ensure one of them is set on all web pages returned by your site/app.

If you expect the page to be framed only by pages on your server (e.g. it's part of a FRAMESET) then you'll want to use SAMEORIGIN, otherwise if you never expect the page to be framed, you should use DENY. Alternatively consider implementing Content Security Policy's "frame-ancestors" directive.

evidence.response_body_snippet: The response does not protect against 'ClickJacking' attacks. It should include either Content-Security-Policy with 'frame-ancestors' directive or X-Frame-Options.
